statement: The cluster service install catalog deterministically serializes overlapping intent, classifies cross-owner insert conflicts through authoritative replay, applies rollout and latest-failure updates with a single-winner durable fence, treats stale failure replay as a no-op, completes partial failure attachment exactly once, and still records unsupported activation as recorded_not_running without owning runtime actual state.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

The bounded replacement covers the existing service install catalog constants, four bootstrap schemas, explicit CDC policies, production owner contract and factory wiring, scenario runner, and production-factory test. Architecture prose is aligned separately after terminal handoff.

Overlapping resource identities are registered synchronously before any await. Durable primary and operation uniqueness is the cross-owner backstop: late success or duplicate insert is authoritatively re-read and returns either the unchanged projection or a closed typed conflict.

Rollout and latest-failure updates use the observed rollout state plus a strictly monotonic updated_at value as a durable compare-and-swap fence. Incompatible concurrent updates produce exactly one durable winner; a stale writer cannot overwrite it.
An already-durable failure replay is a no-op whenever any latest_failure_id is present. An immutable failure left by a partial write may attach exactly once only while that pointer is null.

Package and revision identities remain immutable, initial activation remains recorded_not_running, caller actual-state fields fail closed, corrupt running state is never projected, and services plus service_endpoints retain actual-state ownership.

Deterministic two-owner barriers must prove identical install replay, typed identity conflicts, one-winner rollout and failure races, stale losing-failure no-op, partial failure completion, and lost insert/update response recovery. Independent verification must also re-run the recorded_not_running, package immutability, and actual-state guard revert mutants.
This Quest does not add lifecycle SQL, artifact fetching, reconciliation scheduling, runtime activation, endpoint publication, registry access, or CLI commands.
